Goal: Create a cinematic 4x4 storyboard poster for an emotional sports-anime video about {argument name="character name" default="a young yellow-haired girl"} who struggles to become a professional football player, turning rejection, pain, injuries, and loneliness into determination and success.

Canvas: Vertical poster in a 4:5 ratio, dark cinematic color grade, realistic anime aesthetics, warm golden highlights, deep shadows, dramatic rain and stadium lighting. Divide the canvas into exactly 16 equal panels in a black grid, numbered 1 through 16 in small black square badges at the top-left of each panel. Each panel has a bold yellow uppercase title and short white bullet text on the left side, with an emotional scene illustration filling the panel. Add a full-width bottom banner titled “VIDEO PROMPT (FOR THIS STORY)” with a paragraph prompt and a soccer ball graphic on the right.

Main character: A teenage girl with messy short golden-yellow hair, athletic but small build, expressive emotional body language, usually wearing dark football training clothes or a black football jersey with number 7. Her face may be softly obscured or shadowed for cinematic focus. Show her growing from lonely beginner to celebrated star.

Storyboard panels: Use exactly 16 panels with these visible numbered chapters and scene concepts:
1. “A DREAM BEGINS” — girl at night holding a soccer ball beside an urban fence, watching football on a glowing screen in the distance; bullet points: dreams of becoming a football star, watches matches late at night, practices alone in empty streets, believes football is her destiny.
2. “NOBODY SUPPORTS HER” — girl standing with folded arms while classmates or family silhouettes mock or ignore her; bullet points: people say football is not for girls, friends laugh at her dreams, family worries about her future, but she never gives up.
3. “TRAINING EVERY DAY” — rainy street training scene, girl dribbling intensely through puddles before sunrise; bullet points: wakes up before sunrise, runs in rain and cold mornings, practices dribbling for hours, learns discipline and patience.
4. “FIRST BIG FAILURE” — girl crying alone by a chain-link fence after rejection, soccer ball near her feet and a paper marked “REJECTED”; bullet points: gets rejected from a local academy, cries alone after the trials, feels broken and exhausted, decides to try again stronger.
5. “THE HARDEST PHASE” — exhausted girl studying at a desk under a lamp with books and football notes, showing balance between school and sport; bullet points: balances studies, work and football, shoes become old and torn, trains on rough grounds, keeps chasing her dream silently.
6. “A SMALL OPPORTUNITY” — local coach standing beside her on a muddy practice field, noticing her talent; bullet points: a local coach notices her talent, gets invited to a small girls’ team, starts learning real teamwork, slowly gains confidence.
7. “BUILDING HERSELF” — intense gym/training scene with weights or a stationary bike, sweat and dramatic lighting; bullet points: improves speed and stamina, learns powerful shooting techniques, studies professional players, becomes mentally stronger.
8. “FIRST TOURNAMENT” — girl in black number 7 jersey celebrating or kicking during her first match under stadium lights; bullet points: plays her first important match, feels nervous before kickoff, scores her first goal, her team finally believes in her.
9. “INJURED BUT UNBROKEN” — girl seated with bandaged leg or ankle, injured yet determined, watching from sidelines; bullet points: suffers a painful injury, cannot play for weeks, watches others from the sidelines, fights through pain and recovery.
10. “RETURN TO THE FIELD” — sunset practice field, girl in number 7 jersey seen from behind rejoining teammates; bullet points: comes back stronger than before, trains harder every single day, earns respect from teammates, becomes the team’s key player.
11. “VIRAL RECOGNITION” — close-up of a smartphone showing her match clip going viral, social media hearts and comments around the screen; bullet points: match clips go viral online, people start noticing her talent, gains followers and supporters, her story inspires young girls.
12. “CHAMPIONSHIP MATCH” — massive stadium under bright lights, girl number 7 scoring or celebrating a winning goal with sparks and cheering crowd; bullet points: plays in the biggest match of her life, stadium lights shine brightly, scores the winning goal, crowd cheers her name loudly.
13. “NATIONAL SELECTION” — girl with backpack at sunset city skyline, leaving for bigger competition; include a subtle “INDIA” marking on clothing or bag if desired; bullet points: gets selected for a national camp, travels to bigger cities, faces stronger competition, pushes beyond her limits.
14. “BECOMING A STAR” — magazine cover or interview scene with her holding a soccer ball, headline like “SPORTS WEEKLY” and inspirational slogan “NO DREAM IS TOO BIG”; bullet points: appears in interviews and magazines, signs with a professional club, inspires millions of girls, proves dreams have no gender.
15. “LIVING HER DREAM” — wide stadium shot from behind, girl number 7 raising both arms triumphantly before a huge crowd; bullet points: plays in massive stadiums, supports her family proudly, smiles remembering her struggles, finally lives the life she imagined.
16. “A PROUD MOMENT” — emotional close-up of the now-successful player holding a ball against stadium light, remembering her younger self; bullet points: looks at her younger self’s old football, remembers every failure and sacrifice, realizes the struggle made her stronger, her dream finally became reality.

Bottom banner: Add a dark rectangular banner spanning the full width beneath the 16 panels. Title in bold yellow: “VIDEO PROMPT (FOR THIS STORY)”. Body text in small white type: “Create a cinematic and emotional video about a young girl with yellow hair who struggles to become a professional football player. Show her journey from being ignored, facing failures, injuries, and rejections to rising as a star through hard work and determination. Include training, emotions, matches, crowds, celebrations, and real-life struggles. End with her living her dream and inspiring millions. The video should be motivational, emotional, and visually stunning.” Place a realistic soccer ball on grass at the far right of the banner.

Visual style: Realistic anime sports-drama storyboard, emotional closeups, dynamic camera angles, gritty textures, rain, mud, glowing stadium lights, warm amber rim light, dark blue night shadows, high contrast cinematic composition, motivational atmosphere.

Constraints: Keep exactly 16 numbered panels plus one bottom prompt banner. Use the same young yellow-haired football girl throughout. Keep text legible but compact. No extra panels, no watermark, no unrelated characters, no comedy tone.

content:
EXPRESSIONIST SKETCH PORTRAIT
Subject name: {argument name="subject name" default="[Enter Name Here]"}
Create a 4:5 vertical portrait art poster in the style of {argument name="art style" default="Expressionist drawing, inspired by Egon Schiele"}. The medium should evoke rough white sketch paper texture, using a high contrast monochromatic palette of deep black ink, charcoal grey, and raw white with raw emotional energy and a bold, gallery-quality feel.
Based on the uploaded reference photo, faithfully preserve the subject’s facial features, hairstyle, and personal aura in a half-body portrait composition. The rendering style is expressionist ink and charcoal portraiture, not photography, not cartoon, not anime. Facial details should be rendered with loose gestural lines, visible sketch marks, deliberate smudges, and intentionally unfinished areas that give the subject life and emotional intensity.
On the left side of the composition, write the subject’s full name in large bold expressive brushstroke lettering as a vertical column, with raw ink energy, line variation, and deliberate imperfection that matches the gestural drawing style. The name strokes should feel like they are drawn with the same hand and the same urgency as the portrait itself.
Based on the subject’s name, overall mood, and personal aura, automatically generate one elegant poetic English phrase of 8 to 12 words. The phrase should feel emotionally resonant and not modern colloquial, raw and honest and not overly obscure or kitschy, and deeply evocative of the subject’s inner spirit and temperament. Only this one generated phrase should appear in the composition with no repetition and no full-page text coverage.
This poetic phrase must be rendered in bold expressive brushstroke script and organically compose the contours of the figure, with the gestural letterforms bleeding directly into and tracing the subject’s head silhouette, hair flow, facial outline, neck, shoulder, and upper body lines. The viewer should feel as if the written words and the drawn figure share the same raw ink energy, as if the act of writing the phrase was the same act as drawing the person into existence.
Preserve large areas of raw open white space. In the lower left add loose gestural sketch marks suggesting ground or shadow. In the upper right add sparse expressive mark-making that suggests space and atmosphere without forming a clear image. These background elements must be raw and minimal and must never compete with the portrait.
Style keywords: Expressionist sketch portrait, Schiele-inspired drawing, gestural brushstroke lettering figure construction, high contrast ink and charcoal, figure outline formed by expressive letterforms, raw energy, emotional, bold, gallery-quality art poster.
Avoid: any Chinese characters or Asian script, cartoon or anime style, vivid colors, clean modern fonts, repetitive or excessive text, cluttered composition, overly refined digital art feel, commercial poster kitsch.
title: Expressionist Sketch Art Poster
description: An art poster prompt in the style of Egon Schiele, using monochromatic ink and charcoal textures to create an emotional, gestural portrait.

content:
Please generate a high-quality "Urban Line Atlas Poster."

This image is designed based on the visual language of a "monochrome urban line-drawing travel poster," featuring a complete composition with a large top title, mid-view street depth, core landmarks, flanking buildings, foreground figures, and a bottom signature block.

[Theme City]
City Name: {argument name="city" default="Yichun"}
English Main Title: {argument name="English title" default="FOREST LINE ATLAS / YICHUN CHRONICLE"}
Chinese Title: Yichun · City of Forests
Country/Region: Heilongjiang Province, China
Core Landmarks: Lesser Khingan Mountains forest, Korean pine forest sea, Wuying National Forest Park observation tower
Street Scene: Small forest town streets, residential intersections with wooden buildings, forestry city atmosphere
Emotional Theme: Commuting moments in the morning mist
Main Color Tone: {argument name="main color" default="dark green + dark grey line drawing"}
Aspect Ratio: 3:4 vertical

[Overall Positioning]
This is a work that serves as a travel souvenir poster, an urban visual guide, an architectural line manuscript, and an editorial design cover. The image needs to present Yichun's unique temperament as a "city in the forest," with both urban recognition and a sense of real street life—not a standard travel poster or a single landmark illustration, but a visual archive piece of collectible value.
[Composition Design]
The top is a strong title area using the large English title "FOREST LINE ATLAS," supplemented by the subtitle "YICHUN CHRONICLE." A numbering system (e.g., No. CN-HLJ-YC-01) and brief coordinate info can be added, with a modern and design-oriented layout.
The middle is the urban street主体, using a deep street perspective composition with a slightly low angle, the road extending into the distance and gradually entering the forest area.
The core landmark is the forest observation tower or the silhouette of the Lesser Khingan forest in the distance, clear but not overly prominent, naturally blending into the street scene.
Add local architectural details on both sides: wooden houses, forestry bureau-style buildings, residential blocks, small shops, bus stops, streetlights, utility poles, simple road signs, etc., forming high-density urban information.
The foreground includes lifestyle elements: pedestrians in autumn/winter clothing, people on bicycles, residents with shopping bags, small vehicles, and fallen leaves on the ground to enhance the seasonal atmosphere.
A separate signature area at the bottom is designed as a city archive label structure, containing "YICHUN / HEILONGJIANG / CHINA" and a simplified city info module or map index-style layout.
[Text System]
The top main title is clear and eye-catching. Keep only 2–4 clear readable texts in the image (e.g., "Yichun Station," "Forestry Road," "Bus Stop"), with other signs using abstracted Chinese strokes or symbolic characters to avoid gibberish. The overall text system should be unified, restrained, and integrated into the design structure.
[Visual Style]
The overall style uses monochrome or a very limited two-color line drawing on an off-white or warm white paper texture. Lines are precise, clean, and layered, with the feel of an architectural pen manuscript and screen print texture. Foreground lines are slightly thicker, background lines thinner, with figures and objects being simple but recognizable. The style is restrained and sophisticated.

[Innovation Requirements]
Incorporate design variations in: title naming system, top layout structure, slightly low-angle street perspective, fusion composition of forest and city, bottom archive-style information module, and expression of autumn fallen leaf atmosphere.
[Avoidance Matters]
No ordinary travel poster style, no watercolor, impasto, or cartoon/chibi styles, no cyberpunk, no high-saturation colors, and no cheap souvenir style.

Please generate an independent, complete, high-definition, clear-lined vertical urban line-drawing poster with a sense of collectability and series identity.

Design an ultra cinematic historical archive-style poster with a full-body 3D historical figure as the absolute center focus. The character must appear realistic, monument-like, powerful, and historically accurate with strong cinematic presence. Clothing, armor, robes, weapons, crown, boots, fabric textures, and accessories must accurately match the historical era.

The figure should not stand still. Create a dramatic “breaking out of the frame” action pose toward the viewer with strong cinematic depth and perspective distortion. One arm or symbolic object must extend forward aggressively. The breakout object can be an imperial sword, spear, command scroll, royal decree, military token, book scroll, jade tablet, ceremonial weapon, or dynasty banner. Keep the forward object fully visible and uncropped.

The central figure stands on a refined memorial-style base with subtle historical engravings. The figure should feel visually heavy and dominant while the surrounding information system feels light, elegant, transparent, and floating.

Around the character, place 6–10 floating historical event fragments designed like lightweight museum archive shards instead of thick information cards. Use transparent acrylic/glass panels, glowing borders, fine gold annotation lines, layered infographic fragments, and floating manuscript textures. These fragments may contain years, event titles, short annotations, historical scenes, military maps, dynasty seals, territory outlines, and ancient document textures.

The floating fragments should appear at different depths and angles. Some closer to the camera, some partially hidden behind armor or weapons, creating strong cinematic layering and realistic spatial depth.

content: # Conceptual Crowd Portrait Please generate a visually impactful "Conceptual Crowd Portrait" based on a clear real-life photo uploaded by the user. ## I. Identity Requirements Strictly refer to the real identity characteristics of the person in the uploaded photo, including: - Facial contour - Facial proportions - Eye and brow structure - Nose shape - Lip shape - Hairstyle foundation - Skin tone and sense of age - Gaze and temperament - Overall character recognizability The final image must allow the viewer to immediately recognize the person from the uploaded photo. Do not turn them into a stranger, do not Westernize, do not idolize/beautify excessively, and do not generate a fake AI face. ## II. Core Concept Recreate the portrait as a large-scale conceptual installation art piece. The entire portrait head is composed of thousands of miniature people, arranged densely like a crowd formation. Through different positions, clothing shades, crowd density, and shadow variations, they collectively form the face, hair, features, glasses, beard, clothing outlines, and overall expression of the person in the photo. The image looks like a giant portrait made of a real crowd, or a contemporary art installation placed in a minimalist white space. ## III. Composition - Vertical composition, suitable for visual posters or conceptual covers. - Aerial view / Isometric top-down view. - The portrait head occupies the main subject of the frame. - Background is a minimalist pure white space with significant negative space. - A few small people are scattered around the portrait to enhance the sense of spatial proportion and realistic scale. - The crowd as a whole forms a clear outline, and facial features must be accurately placed. ## IV. Visual Elements ### Crowd Structure - Use dense crowds to form hair, eyebrows, eyes, bridge of the nose, lips, jawline, and clothes. - Dark-clothed people form hair, glasses, collars, and shadow areas. - Light-clothed people form facial highlights and skin areas. - The arrangement should be natural, with a realistic sense of crowding and small random variations. - Each miniature person should have an independent posture, clothing, and direction, avoiding a copy-paste look. ### Lighting Effects - Soft cinematic lighting. - Low-angle long shadows. - Natural shadows cast at the feet of the crowd. - Unified shadow direction to enhance spatial realism. - Overall clean, high-end, and quiet aesthetic. ### Color Style - Warm neutral tones. - Primarily off-white, light brown, gray, and charcoal black. - Dark clothing used to strengthen character outlines. - Skin areas transitioned with light beige and warm gray crowds. - Restrained color palette, avoiding excessive vibrancy. ## V. Art Style Overall style references: - Contemporary conceptual art. - Museum-grade installation art. - Hyper-realistic crowd simulation. - Minimalist visual posters. - High-end digital art. - Social metaphor visual works. - Cinematic conceptual photography. The image should have a strong visual metaphor: An individual's image is composed of countless tiny individuals, offering both the shock of a macro portrait and the explorability of micro-crowd details. ## VI. Mood Overall atmospheric keywords: - Surreal - Profound - Quiet - High-end - Modern - Thought-provoking - Cinematic - Visually shocking - Shareable ## VII. Rendering Quality - Ultra-high detail. - 8K texture. - Realistic crowd simulation. - Deep focus, ensuring the entire crowd portrait is clearly visible. - Rich details in miniature figures. - Realistic spatial proportions. - Clean image with no cluttered background. - High-end commercial visual quality. - Similar to Octane Render / high-end 3D conceptual rendering effects. ## VIII. Negative Constraints Please avoid the following: - Do not turn the person into a stranger. - Do not just generate a normal portrait. - Do not generate simple collages. - Do not let the crowd lose the portrait outline. - No misplacement of facial features. - No blurred facial structures. - No exaggerated cartoon style. - No low-resolution posters. - No messy backgrounds. - Do not make all miniature people look identical. - No text, watermarks, or logos. - No excessive beautification. - Do not change the person's sense of age or authentic temperament.
title: Conceptual Crowd Portrait Installation Art

content:
Design a high-end cinematic character poster in a layered depth composition (9:16 vertical) with a strong foreground–midground–background separation instead of silhouette framing.
The {argument name="character" default="character"} stands slightly off-center in a dynamic, perspective-driven pose, interacting naturally with the {argument name="environment" default="environment (wind, light, particles, fabric movement)"}. The camera angle should feel intentional—low-angle for power or slight tilt for tension—creating a sense of motion and presence.
The background should not be contained inside shapes. Instead, build a living world around the character:
atmospheric environments (fog, city lights, ruins, nature, etc.)
light rays, volumetric glow, drifting particles
subtle storytelling elements placed naturally in space (not collage-based)
Introduce floating fragments or layered planes (glass shards, light panels, memories, holographic slices, or torn paper edges) that orbit or intersect the scene, each containing faint symbolic visuals tied to the character’s story—keep them minimal and elegant, not cluttered.
Lighting should be cinematic and directional:
strong key light shaping the subject
rim lighting to separate from background
soft gradients and shadow falloff for depth
Color palette should follow a {argument name="color palette" default="controlled dual-tone system (e.g., teal–orange, violet–gold, crimson–black)"} with smooth transitions and no oversaturation.
Typography:
place the title in a clean, modern cinematic layout
integrate text subtly into the environment (ground plane, light projection, or floating UI style)
avoid heavy or oversized typography
Overall style: ultra-realistic + cinematic editorial, sharp detail on subject, soft atmospheric depth in background, minimal but intentional storytelling elements, premium movie-poster quality.
Avoid: silhouette fill compositions, heavy collage density, watercolor textures, or ink-wash edges. Focus on spatial depth, realism, and cinematic immersion.
title: Cinematic Character Poster with Layered Depth
description: A prompt designed to create high-end movie posters featuring a strong sense of spatial depth and cinematic lighting, focusing on a character interacting naturally with an atmospheric environment.

content:
Please generate a high-quality, high-definition poster-style storyboard for "{argument name="subject" default="Street Freestyle Football"} · {argument name="action" default="16-Step Action Breakdown"}." The layout should be a square 4x4 grid, with each cell showing a consecutive action step of the same street football performer in the same setting. The entire image should look like a combination of a high-end sports poster and a technical breakdown instructional board, possessing both visual impact and a clear sense of movement explanation.

[Overall Setting]
Theme: Street freestyle football performance (not a match or drill), where one performer completes a continuous set of tricks.
Atmosphere: Street vibe, urban, cinematic, athletic, cool, and rhythmic.
Background: Set in a {argument name="background" default="nighttime urban small street pitch"} or city square football space, with graffiti walls, wire fences, distant building lights, street lamps, and slightly reflective ground. The environment must be consistent and have a trendy street aesthetic.

[Character Requirements]
Protagonist: A young, handsome male freestyle football expert with a light, coordinated, and athletic build, short black hair, confident aura, and fluid, controlled movements.
The same person must appear in all 16 cells; do not change the person per cell.
Outfit: Cool-looking football kit, but no words like "Champion" or specific country names. The clothing should feel like a professional team jersey.

[Layout Requirements]
The full image is a 4x4 grid of 16 cells. Each cell must contain:
1. Large step number (1-16)
2. Chinese action title
3. 2-4 brief Chinese action points
4. Clear full-body action shot of the person
5. Football trajectory arrows / footwork paths
6. The ball must be clearly visible and logically positioned.

Overall font style: Sporty poster aesthetic, clear and powerful. The image should be sharp, clean, and the person and ball must be complete, not cut off at the feet.

[Action Sequence]
Please design 16 continuous actions in order, each distinctly different, forming a complete freestyle routine: [Detailed steps 1-16 including Starting Pose, Sole Pull, Stepover, Flick-up, Knee Control, Around the World, Shoulder Stall, Rainbow Flick, and Final Bow].

[Visual Style]
- High-end sports poster style
- Cinematic night lighting and shadows
- Strong sense of motion with a trendy street aesthetic
- Clear arrows and trajectory lines to help understand the path of the ball
- Color palette dominated by red, black, and gold for a premium feel
- Eye-catching typography suitable for social media
title: Freestyle Football 16-Step Action Poster

[1. Execution Mode — Critical]

This is an image editing task, NOT image generation.

Use the original photo as the base layer
Do NOT recreate, redraw, or reinterpret the image

Strictly preserve:

face, identity, expression, hair, body, clothing
original lighting, shadows, color temperature
environment and composition

❗ No beautification, no smoothing, no retouching
❗ The photo must look unchanged

[2. Allowed Operations — Overlay Only]

Only add design elements on top:

bottom 30% soft gradient extension (for calendar area)
subtle translucent mask for readability
calendar layout, month title, and short caption

Forbidden:

repainting or altering existing pixels
changing global color style
applying “design filters”
[3. Color Strategy]

Colors must come from the current image:

extract primary / secondary / accent colors
apply slight desaturation and brightness normalization only
keep original photo color feeling

👉 Respect the image, do not redesign the color system

[4. Layout Structure]
Top 70%: original image (untouched)
Bottom 30%: gradient + calendar
smooth transition, no hard edges
clean spacing, minimal design
magazine-like, not template-style
[5. Calendar Content — Must Be Accurate]

Generate correct calendar for the given month:

Title: {argument name="month title" default="July 2026 / 2026.07"}
Weekdays: Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun
Dates: accurate alignment based on real calendar
[6. Caption Rules — Important]

Length: 8–16 words (or equivalent short phrase)

Requirements:

max 2 lines
no exclamation marks
no clichés, no motivational tone
do NOT explain emotions

Preferred style:

subtle, atmospheric
fragment-like, not fully explanatory
leave emotional space

👉 Make people pause, not finish reading

[7. Image Selection Guidance — Key to Success]

Prefer:

side face / partially hidden face
natural遮挡 (hat, hand, shadow)
motion (walking, turning)
mood > facial detail

Avoid:
front-facing portraits
strong identity-focused close-ups

👉 Reduce face-modification risk

[Final Principle]

👉 Do NOT generate a better photo.
Gently place design on the original photo.

content:
Based on the real travel photo I uploaded, generate a 9:16 aspect ratio 'Monthly Calendar Card'.

[1. Execution Method (Most Important)]
This is a photo editing task, not a regeneration. You must use the original photo as the base layer:
- Keep the person's features, expression, hairstyle, and posture completely unchanged.
- Preserve original lighting, color temperature, and shadow relationships.
- No skin smoothing, brightening, repainting, or stylization.
- Do not change environment, composition, or color atmosphere.
- The original photo must look untouched.

[2. Permitted Operations (Overlay Only)]
Only design layers may be added over the original photo:
- Gradient extension on the bottom 30% (for the calendar).
- Soft translucent mask (to ensure text readability).
- Calendar layout + Month Title + Copywriting.
Prohibited: Repainting subject/background, changing overall tone, or applying design filters.

[3. Color Rules]
Colors must be extracted from the current image (main/secondary/accent colors). Only slight desaturation and brightness unification allowed. Maintain authentic color feel.

[4. Layout Structure]
Top 70%: Original photo (untouched).
Bottom 30%: Gradient + Calendar area (natural transition). Must look like a magazine page, not a template calendar.

[5. Calendar Content]
Automatically generate the corresponding year and month:
- Title: {argument name="date title" default="July 2026 / 2026.07"}
- Days: Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun
- Dates: Arranged according to a real calendar, strictly aligned.

[6. Copywriting Rules]
Length: 8-16 characters. Max two lines. No exclamation marks. No clichés or life lessons. Use emotional fragments or atmospheric sentences.

[7. Selection Advice]
Prefer side profiles, tilted heads, or dynamic movements over close-up front-facing portraits to reduce AI facial distortion risk.

Final Core Rule: Do not make a 'better' photo; lightly place a design layer over the existing one.

content: Using the uploaded logo, create a high-quality professional poster for an integrated brand identity system. Goal: Everything must be based on the logo: Colors, Style, Personality, and Tone. ❌ No generic or random elements allowed. 🧱 Structure: Vertical poster with a 4:5 ratio, a clear and multi-layered Grid system; the design should be content-dense but clean and organized. 🔝 Top Section: Brand name in a clear and clean font, a short slogan expressing the brand (max 6 words), and an identity description in three words (e.g., modern / bold / simple). 🎨 Color System (Professional): Display primary colors (3–5), secondary colors (3–5), and accent colors. For each color, provide clear color blocks, HEX codes, and usage (Background / Primary / Accent). Add color gradients and color blending examples. 🔤 Typography: Specify heading font, subheading font, and body text font. Show real text examples and a clear hierarchy between sizes. 🖼️ Visual Identity: Specify image style (cinematic / minimalist / editorial…), lighting direction, and type of materials and textures. Display 3 to 5 visual examples (image style). 📦 Brand Applications (Very Important): Show realistic mockups such as product packaging, website interface (Hero Section), mobile app screen, 3 social media posts, business card, and an advertisement or billboard. ⚠️ All must share the same identity spirit. 🧩 Design System: Display UI components, cards, and spacing systems. Examples: buttons, layouts, and sections. 🔘 Icons: 6 to 10 icons in the same style (Line or Filled), consistent with the identity. 🎭 Patterns and Elements: Background patterns, decorative shapes, and elements inspired by the logo. ✨ Fine Details: Shadows, textures, reflections, and layer depth. 🎯 Overall Style: A mix between Editorial Design + Tech Style; very clean but rich in detail with a strong and clear hierarchy. 📊 Density: 30 to 50 visual elements; a mix of large and small elements in an intelligently crowded and organized design. 🚫 Important Rules: No empty spaces without a reason, no filler elements, everything has a purpose, and all elements are visually interconnected. 💎 Final Result: It must look like a strong project on Behance or an identity guide from a design agency. Something that makes the client ask: "How much?" 😏 NOT: Simple, traditional, or a ready-made template.

The subject appears full-body and sharp, wearing an {argument name="outfit style" default="avant-garde fashion styling"} that feels modern and editorial (clean silhouette, stylish layering, premium fabric texture). Keep clothing tasteful and fashion-forward. The subject’s pose should feel athletic, stylish, and unusual—like a magazine campaign shot.

Lighting: studio quality, crisp and cinematic; strong key light with controlled soft shadows, subtle rim light; realistic reflections and bounce light from the colored walls. Ultra-detailed skin texture, natural pores, realistic fabric weave, clean edges, high dynamic range. 
Composition: subject centered with plenty of negative space and strong geometric lines; the box perspective frames the subject. 
Color: the box color is a SINGLE bold color and MUST be different each run (random vivid hue). The subject’s outfit contrasts well with the box color.

Output: hyper-real, photorealistic, 8k detail, editorial campaign quality, sharp focus on subject, no motion blur, no distortion of face, natural proportions.

- Strong iconic giant silhouette at the top
- Focus on visual impact
- Convey the character's symbol at a glance

[Collage/Double Exposure]
- Multiple elements contained within the giant silhouette
- Layering scenes, symbolic motifs, and environments
- Building a narrative
- Integrating into mist, ink, or negative space

[World-Building Expression]
- Multiple scenes based on the character's worldview
- Placement of symbolic motifs
- Movement or staging of smaller characters
- Environmental details (nature/architecture/atmosphere)

[Layout (Left-Right Composition)]
- Complementary elements placed on the left and right
- Providing rhythm to the composition
- Creating narrative tension

[Gaze Direction Design]
- A single visual line flowing from top to bottom
- Upper giant silhouette -> internal collage -> lower full-body character
- Continuous visual guidance design

[Margins & Edge Treatment]
- Large use of negative space
- Edge effects: ink bleeding, soft blur, fragmentary decomposition

[Aesthetics & Concept]
- Reflecting Eastern aesthetics: negative space, presence, imperfection
- Coexistence of silence and tension

[Style & Tone]
- Unified visual appearance
- Refined expression
- Restrained tone, avoiding information overload

[Finish Quality]
- High depth of field expression
- Strong visual impact
- Emphasis on storytelling

content:
Generate a [medium information density] book summary infographic poster with the theme "{argument name="book title" default="Book Title"}".

---

Step 0 (Critical Pre-assessment)

Before starting generation, determine which category this book belongs to (multiple choice possible):
* Cognitive Growth (Thinking / Self-improvement)
* Business / Wealth (Earning / Career / Investment)
* Psychology / Emotion (Relationships / Inner Self / Human Nature)
* Novel / Story (Narrative / Character / Metaphor)

Adjust content logic based on category.

[Overall Style]
Modern Minimalist UI + Light Vintage Illustration style. Soft light backgrounds (Cream / Beige / Light Gray). Low saturation palette (Deep Green / Deep Blue / Brown).
Keywords: Quiet, Substantial, Readable.

[Core Principles]
Do not use fixed module titles. Do not force structural completeness. Organize information naturally based on book type.

[Content Modules]
1. Opening: Book Title, Author, One-sentence insight.
2. Core Understanding: "What this book is really saying is..."
3. Highlights: Key takeaways adjusted by category.
4. Visual Structure: Decision paths, leverage systems, or character maps.
5. Examples/Fragments: Memorable scenes or cases.
6. Quotes: Meaningful sentences.
7. Actions: Practical steps to take after reading.

[Design Details]
Adaptive grid layout, card-based info, 6:4 image-to-text ratio, unified illustration style, clear hierarchy.

[Tone of Voice]
Should sound like a human explaining the book with insight and realization, not like a dry summary.

content: Create a bold Chinese promotional poster in a chaotic Mondrian-meets-Fauvism-meets-Cubism graphic style, with thick black outlines, irregular geometric color blocks, and a high-contrast palette of red, blue, yellow, white, and black. The layout is a dense single-page vertical membership campaign poster with multiple tilted panels and sharp angular divisions, like cut-paper collage and retro commercial poster design. At the top center, place a huge white trapezoid panel with oversized black Chinese headline text: "大会员" on the first line and "首次招募" on the second line, with the year {argument name="year" default="2026"} in large bright blue numerals integrated into the headline. Along the left side, include 4 decorative icon/mascot elements: 1 circular bear-face logo in a yellow circle at the upper left, 1 blue-and-white clock icon below it, 1 half-body black-and-white bear mascot in the mid-left wearing a blue scarf and raising one arm, and 1 cropped bear mascot face at the bottom left. In the left-center, add a tall red countdown panel with white Chinese text "倒计时仅剩" at the top, an enormous yellow numeral "1" in the middle, and a large white "天" at the bottom. On the upper right, place a large white pricing panel showing the original price line "原价 ¥2999/年" with a strikethrough over 2999, then the discounted line "到手价" above a giant red price "¥1299/年". Beneath that, create a blue header strip labeled "省钱攻略" and divide the area into 3 vertical offer columns labeled 1, 2, and 3. Column 1 shows "领券立减" and a large blue "200" with a percent-style coupon icon below. Column 2 shows "拼团再减" and a large red "1500" with three simplified person icons in blue, yellow, and red below. Column 3 shows "成团即得" and a large red "¥730" with smaller black text "专属赠礼" and a gift box icon below. In the lower left, add a white benefits panel with a blue tab title "核心权益". Inside, place 2 small rectangular portrait thumbnails at the upper left, then to the right list 3 text rows: "AI × 家庭教育 × 元学习", a blue-highlighted name "howie" followed by black Chinese descriptive text, and a red-highlighted name "savage" followed by black Chinese descriptive text. Under these, include 4 bullet-like benefit rows with small blue icons: "全年直播陪伴，会员无限期回看", "会员专享逐字稿 + 三级笔记", "All in One AI 知识库 24*7 答疑", and "免费送一个家庭账号，和队友一起学". Across the lower middle, create a black horizontal strip with white text: "AI 内参 1 年（¥365） + 实物大礼包（¥365）". Below that strip, show 3 product images side by side: 1 magazine-style booklet cover, 1 orange notebook/book cover, and 1 blue book cover, plus 2 small round mascot badges near the products. At the bottom center, place a large blue call-to-action panel with big white Chinese text "扫码立刻拼团" and yellow subtitle text "— 锁定首发价 —", then a smaller line in white and yellow: "平均每天 3.55，撬动全家 AI 学习力！". At the bottom right, add a large black-and-white QR code in a white square. Along the very bottom, create 2 footer bars: on the left a blue strip with a shield icon and white text "价保承诺：180 天降价立即退差价", and on the right a red strip with a card/payment icon and white text "轻松支付：花呗 12 期分期免息". Use very heavy sans-serif Chinese typography, exaggerated scale contrast, dynamic asymmetrical composition, overlapping panels, and an energetic commercial poster feel for social media marketing.

Create a polished two-page magazine spread in Japanese, styled like a contemporary creator profile feature in a premium design and culture magazine. The layout is a clean editorial interview spread with a white background, navy blue accents, thin rule lines, elegant typography, and a balanced grid. The overall feeling is sophisticated, modern, and slightly masculine, like a feature on a handsome AI visual creator.

On the left page, place a very large stacked English headline at the top left reading “CREATOR INTERVIEW” in bold condensed sans-serif, with small vertical issue text along the outer margin such as “VOL.23 / MAY 2024.” Beneath and across most of the left page, use a large cinematic photo of a {argument name="creator identity" default="male AI visual creator"} sitting at a desk in a dark hoodie in a moody studio workspace. The face is intentionally soft-blurred or anonymized. The room is warm and dimly lit, with multiple monitors showing image-editing or visual-generation work, a desk lamp, and walls covered in concept art, posters, sketches, and fantasy artwork. Overlay the lower-left of the photo with a large Japanese feature title in white Mincho-style serif text: “Xで世界観を育てる、AI表現の実験室。” Add smaller Japanese body text beneath introducing the account @multusdim_AI and describing an experimental AI art practice that values atmosphere, prompt design, and visual worldbuilding. At the bottom of the left page, include a horizontal block of smaller Japanese editorial text summarizing the creator’s focus and interview context.

On the right page, create 5 clearly separated editorial sections. Section 1 is the main interview column titled “INTERVIEW” at the top in blue uppercase sans-serif. Below it, format 4 Q&A entries in Japanese, each beginning with a blue “Q.” and “A.” The questions and answers should discuss the creator’s reason for posting on X, what they care about when making work, recurring motifs, and what they observe in audience reactions. Midway down this same interview column, add a large blue pull quote in Japanese with oversized quotation marks: “AIでつくるのは画像ではなく、空気ごと伝わる体験。” Section 2 is a top-right image card with a warm café portrait of a soft, elegant maid-themed woman holding a drink, paired with the visible label “MAID” and a short Japanese blurb. Section 3 is a second image card below it showing a rainy retro-futuristic city street with a car and neon reflections, labeled “RETRO FUTURE” with a short Japanese blurb. Section 4 is a third image card below that featuring a detailed steampunk city or giant clockwork structure with smoke and brass machinery, labeled “STEAMPUNK” with a short Japanese blurb. Section 5 is a fourth image card at the bottom showing a casual everyday snapshot of a young woman outdoors in warm sunset light, labeled “EVERYDAY SNAP” with a short Japanese blurb.

At the bottom of the right page, add 3 boxed information panels. The first is a “PROFILE” box with the account name “@multusdim_AI” and several lines of Japanese profile text describing an AI visual creator focused on atmosphere-rich work blending photorealism, retro future, maid aesthetics, and steampunk. The second is a “KEYWORDS” box listing exactly 6 keyword items in Japanese separated by slashes: “フォトリアル / プロンプト設計 / メイド / レトロフューチャー / スチームパンク / X運用 / AIアート” with the same editorial feel. The third is a dark blue horizontal follow banner reading “Follow: @multusdim_AI”. Add page numbers 26 and 27 at the bottom corners and small footer text like “CREATOR INTERVIEW” and “MAY 2024 / VOL.32”. Use realistic magazine print spacing, sharp editorial hierarchy, and a highly believable Japanese magazine layout.

content: Create a side-by-side comparison graphic on a black background with a faint gray grid, styled like a Chinese social media benchmark post comparing two AI-generated supercar posters. At the very top, place 2 large headings: on the left in bold yellow text, “GPT image 2”, and on the right in bold white text, “Nano Banana”. Centered beneath them, show 2 distinct vertical racing poster designs placed next to each other with a narrow gap. The left poster should look like a dramatic high-end motorsport advertisement in black, red, and white, featuring a glossy red hypercar speeding on a wet racetrack at dusk with cinematic reflections, motion blur, and aggressive lighting. Include a small brand mark at top left, a giant title “VORTEX X7” with “X7” in bright red, and a subtitle like “BORN FOR SPEED. BUILT TO WIN.” Add 2 laurel-like badges on the right of the title area. In the lower half, include 3 content blocks: a left “SPECIFICATIONS” column with exactly 7 listed rows with icon bullets and labels for engine, horsepower, top speed, acceleration, transmission, drivetrain, curb weight, plus fuel capacity if needed as a compact final row; a middle “FEATURES” column with exactly 5 bullet points; and a bold pricing block with “STARTING AT” and a large red price of {argument name="price" default="$189,900"}. Add 1 limited-production badge, 1 slogan block reading “FEEL THE SPEED. OWN THE TRACK.”, and 1 red call-to-action strip reading “ORDER NOW”. Use tiny footer details and contact-style microtext along the bottom edge. The right poster should look more editorial and technical, in navy blue, charcoal, beige, and orange accents, featuring a dark blue hypercar drifting on a racetrack with smoke and landscape in the background. At the top, use a premium magazine-style header with 3 stacked title lines: “FORMULA APEX | AETHELRED APEX”, “CHAMPIONSHIP HERITAGE”, and a performance subtitle. In the lower portion, create a dense spec-sheet layout with exactly 8 major sections: “SPECIFICATION SHEET”, “COMPETITION PACK OPTIONS”, “ENGINE”, “SUSPENSION”, “CHASSIS”, “DRIVETRAIN”, “LAUNCH EDITION | RESERVE NOW”, and “SERVICE & SUPPORT”. Include a small performance graph, a boxed options panel with 3 icon cards, a launch price line showing {argument name="launch price" default="$2,850,000 USD"}, a build-slots area showing exactly 50 units worldwide, an allocation or progress tracker with segmented bars, a line stating production begins in {argument name="production year" default="2025"}, and dense fine-print technical copy. Beneath both posters, add a rounded rectangular black prompt box outlined in white, spanning most of the width. Attach a yellow rounded label overlapping its top-left corner containing the Chinese text “提示词”. Inside the box, place one line of bold white Chinese text: {argument name="prompt text" default="生成一张赛车海报图片，包含规格参数和价格信息。"}. The whole composition should feel like a polished AI image comparison screenshot for social media, with sharp typography, high contrast, clean alignment, and realistic poster mockup proportions.

content:
What you will generate is not a regular illustration, but a high-end concept poster that expresses the meaning and symbolism of the person and name "{argument name="person name" default="ELON MUSK"}" as a visual metaphor.

Place the giant letters "{argument name="person name" default="ELON MUSK"}" as the main protagonist of the entire screen. The letters should be thick, powerful sans-serif characters with an overwhelming presence. The background should be {argument name="background color" default="deep black"}, and the characters a slightly yellowish off-white, with paper texture, graininess, and light scuffs like vintage silkscreen printing or old posters.

At the bottom center, place a monochrome portrait of a man reminiscent of Elon Musk. It should have an atmosphere similar to the person himself, with an expression looking up at the future. The face should not be too realistic, but expressed with strong shadows in a print/poster style.

In the upper right, include a composition where a rocket is launching diagonally upward. Use {argument name="accent color" default="red"} as an accent color for the rocket's exhaust flames and smoke, and have it pass through the giant letters as if cutting through them. This visualizes the meaning of "breaking through to the future," "breaking through existing frameworks," and "large-scale challenges."

Make the overall design a minimalist and powerful graphic poster. Do not add too many elements; compose it only with the text, the person, the rocket, and the red smoke. The composition should be bold and designed to leave an impression at a glance, even from a distance.

In the lower left, add small auxiliary text like "VISION / SCALE / MOTION," and in the lower right, "BUILD THE FUTURE." You may discreetly place small symbols associated with Tesla or X if necessary, but the main focus remains the symbolism of the name "ELON MUSK" and the person.

Unify the colors around three main colors: black, off-white, and red. Create a concept poster with a strong visual memory that conveys luxury, futurism, ambition, solitude, a sense of scale, and the energy of destruction and creation.

content:
Create a vertical poster composition on aged cream paper with a handmade analog feel. Use rough ripped paper edges, layered magazine cutouts, photocopy grain, halftone texture, ink bleed, and slightly imperfect screen-print registration. Keep the subject as the main black-and-white photographic portrait, placed prominently in the center or upper center.

Surround the subject with graphic blocks of deep red, cobalt blue, warm yellow, black, and ivory. Add supporting collage fragments such as a rainy European street, film-strip borders, newspaper clippings, urban silhouettes, and cinematic details, arranged like a handmade 1960s art-house movie poster.

Use bold condensed typography with a strong visual hierarchy. Add large headline text: “{argument name="main title" default="[MAIN TITLE]"}”. Add smaller subtitle text: “{argument name="subtitle" default="[SUBTITLE]"}”. Add bottom text: “{argument name="event details" default="[BRAND NAME / EVENT NAME / COMING SOON / DATE]"}”. If needed, include a small top line reading “[TAGLINE]”.

The final result should feel cinematic, intellectual, rebellious, and editorial — like a lost 1960s European film poster with a strong point of view. Keep it raw, tactile, printed, imperfect, and handmade. Avoid a glossy modern finish.

content: A polished Japanese museum exhibition poster in a contemporary anime illustration style, vertical layout, warm ivory and gold color palette with pastel confetti accents, designed like a high-end promotional ad for a spring holiday event. The composition features 4 school-age to young adult female characters in the foreground and one monumental Buddhist statue in the background. At center back is a towering gilded Thousand-Armed Kannon statue with a radiant halo, intricate carved details, many arms fanning outward symmetrically, and hands pressed together in prayer at the chest, glowing with sacred golden light. In the foreground on the right is the largest figure, a friendly young woman guide or older student reaching one hand dramatically toward the viewer in forced perspective; she has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} shoulder-length hair, a blue striped blouse, a cream sweater draped over her shoulders, and a light skirt, with a warm inviting expression. Across the lower middle are 3 younger schoolgirls in matching uniforms: short-sleeve pale blue shirts with navy ribbon ties and dark blue skirts. The left girl points upward excitedly with one arm raised and wears a small shoulder bag; the center girl holds an exhibition booklet upright; the right girl drinks from a clear water bottle while looking toward the scene. Give all 4 girls lively anime-style faces, glossy hair, soft shading, and energetic museum-outing body language. Fill the poster with dense Japanese typography and decorative graphic shapes. Place a large bold main headline on the left reading {argument name="headline text" default="国宝を見に行こう!"}, with oversized gold and black calligraphy-style characters and one red-highlighted character. Above it, add smaller text: "千手観音、祈りの宇宙". Add a red circular callout near the top left that says "はじめての美術館にもおすすめ!" and a white cloud-shaped speech bubble near the top right that says "いっしょに新しい発見をしよう!". Add a gold ribbon banner under the main headline reading "アスキー美術館 GW開催". Include a pale blue circular information box on the left with 5 lines of Japanese copy describing the statue: "国宝 千手観音立像", "千の手が、千年の祈りを", "伝える", "圧巻のスケールを、", "その目で感じてみて。". In the lower left, place a dark rectangular exhibition plaque with gold trim and 5 text lines: "アスキー美術館 GW特別展", the large title "国宝展", then "千手観音、祈りの宇宙", then the date line {argument name="event dates" default="2026.4.26 SAT - 6.15 SUN"}. Along the bottom center, add the museum name in large text: {argument name="museum name" default="アスキー美術館"}, followed by a smaller address line and nearest-station access text in Japanese. Add a red-and-black slogan along the bottom right: "心に残る体験が、きっとここに。". In the lower right, include 3 circular benefit icons with captions: one peach circle with a ticket icon and text "学生はお得! 学生証提示で当日券200円OFF!", one blue circle with a camera icon and text "撮影OK! 一部の作品は写真撮影OK!", and one gold circle with a gift icon and text "来場者プレゼント! オリジナルしおりをプレゼント!". Scatter subtle sparkles, halftone dots, abstract blobs, and confetti shapes around the page. Overall mood: inviting, educational, elegant, and exciting, combining sacred cultural grandeur with cheerful youthful discovery, like a fictional premium museum advertisement generated as a complete poster with integrated typography.

content:
Goal: Create a polished luxury real-estate brochure board for {argument name="residence name" default="京軌天璽"}, an upscale apartment development branded as {argument name="English subtitle" default="Beijing South Railway Station Residences"}. The design should look like a premium Beijing apartment sales brochure, with architectural visualization, floor plans, interior renders, and rooftop amenities.

Canvas: Wide horizontal brochure, approximately 16:9 ratio, dark charcoal and navy palette with thin gold divider lines and refined white typography. Use a clean grid layout with three main vertical zones: floor plans on the left, hero architecture in the center, and interior/amenity preview images on the right. Add a slim footer bar across the full width.

Layout: Left column contains exactly 2 stacked black-background architectural floor plan diagrams with white blueprint linework. The top floor plan is labeled “PREMIUM UNIT - 3LDK” and shows labeled rooms including bath room, powder room, balcony, master bedroom, bedroom, bedroom, living dining kitchen, terrace, closet areas, and small fixtures. The lower floor plan is labeled “STANDARD UNIT - 2LDK” and shows labeled rooms including bath room, powder room, shoe closet, master bedroom, bedroom, living dining kitchen, closet/storage, and fixtures. Make the floor plans technical, precise, and dense, with small room labels and dimensions.

Center panel: A large dusk hero render of a futuristic glass mixed-use residential tower complex above Beijing South Railway Station. Show multiple illuminated high-rise blocks with cantilevered volumes, sky terraces, warm interior lights, and podium levels. In the foreground, include exactly 7 visible high-speed train sets or train streaks on parallel rail tracks beneath the complex, conveying a major transport hub. Place the large Chinese title “京軌天璽” near the top in elegant gold serif lettering, with the subtitle “Beijing South Railway Station Residences” below it in smaller gold serif type. Include station signage on the building facade reading “北京南站” and “BEIJING SOUTH RAILWAY STATION”.

Right column: Arrange exactly 6 preview image panels. Top row has 2 panels: “ENTRANCE” showing a warm modern apartment hallway with console table, plants, wood cabinetry, recessed lighting, and a dark entry door; “FAMILY ROOM” showing a luxurious living room with sofa, bookcase, coffee table, city view windows, and the large white logo text “Pollo.ai” overlaid. Middle row has 2 panels: “BEDROOM” showing a modern bedroom with a neatly made bed, bedside lamp, warm wood tones, and a city skyline view; “BATHROOM” showing a sleek stone bathroom with vanity, mirror, glass shower, toilet, warm lighting, and beige-brown tiles. Bottom section has 2 stacked labels/panels: a dark header labeled “ROOFTOP AMENITIES”, and a wide image labeled “ROOFTOP GARDEN” showing a landscaped rooftop terrace with planters, seating, pergola canopy, railings, and a panoramic city and railway-station view at dusk.

Footer: Add a thin full-width black footer bar divided into three text zones by vertical gold lines. Left text: “Beijing South Railway Station”. Center text: {argument name="district text" default="北京市丰台区"}. Right text: {argument name="contact email" default="info@jingguitianxi.com"}.

Visual style: Photorealistic architectural visualization mixed with brochure graphic design, high-end real estate marketing, sharp lines, realistic lighting, glossy glass towers, warm interiors, cinematic dusk atmosphere, subtle gold accents, precise typography, no people. Keep all panel labels in uppercase white sans-serif except the main Chinese title in gold serif. Maintain clean margins, straight grid alignment, and a premium corporate presentation.
title: Luxury Beijing Apartment Brochure
description: Generates a premium real-estate brochure layout for a Beijing railway-station residential development with floor plans, tower render, interiors, and rooftop amenities.

content: Create a vintage French New Wave political cinema poster as a torn-paper collage, vertical one-sheet composition, aged and distressed like a weathered 1968 street poster pasted on a wall. Use a limited palette of cream paper, faded black, deep red, mustard yellow, and muted cobalt blue, with heavy analog film grain, halftone print texture, ink bleed, fold creases, scratches, rough paper fibers, ripped edges, glue stains, and slightly misregistered letterpress typography. In the center, place a large black-and-white portrait of a brooding young man in a dark coat, seen in three-quarter profile, cropped from chest up, with curly dark hair and his face partially obscured by a rectangular censor-like paper block, giving the image a mysterious art-house feel. Surround the portrait with torn collage fragments: at upper left, a red paper panel with a black silhouette of a running protester; beneath it, a narrow off-white text strip reading “PARIS, MAI 68” and smaller French copy “LES MURS ONT DES OREILLES, L’AVENIR AUSSI.”; along the far left edge, a vertical black film-strip border with “36 KODAK TRI-X PAN FILM” in white; at lower left, a mustard-yellow torn panel with a cropped dark silhouette portrait; at upper right, a blue torn panel containing the quote “UN FILM COUP DE POING ET DE POÉSIE.” with “— CAHIERS DU CINÉMA” below; directly below that, a tall black-and-white photo fragment of a lone figure walking down a wet Paris street at night under lampposts; near the middle-right, a small torn newsprint block with the French slogan “LA BEAUTÉ EST DANS LA RUE” above a crowd scene; at lower right, a red torn panel with a black silhouette of a domed Paris landmark. Across the very top, centered in narrow black capitals, add the tagline “NOT EVERY REVOLUTION IS TELEVISED.” Near the lower middle, in small black condensed type, add “A FILM BY {argument name="director name" default="JEAN-PIERRE LEMAIRE"}”. Make the main title dominate the lower half in huge condensed red uppercase letters over torn cream paper: “{argument name="French title" default="L’HOMME QUI RÊVAIT"}”. Directly underneath, in smaller blue condensed capitals, add the English subtitle “{argument name="English subtitle" default="THE MAN WHO DREAMED"}”. At the bottom center, place a black strip with large white condensed capitals reading “COMING SOON”, and below it smaller text “ÉTÉ 1968”. In the bottom left corner, include a Cannes-style laurel mark with “SÉLECTION OFFICIELLE FESTIVAL DE CANNES 1968”. In the bottom right corner, add tiny production credits in French, including “UNE PRODUCTION LES FILMS DU SOLEIL DISTRIBUTION”. Keep the whole design asymmetrical, raw, rebellious, and elegant, evoking Godard, Truffaut, May 1968 protest graphics, and handmade French art-house poster collage.

description: A distressed 1960s-style French art-house movie poster collage for creating rebellious vintage cinema graphics with torn paper, bold typography, and political street-poster energy.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 poster, warm off-white rice paper background with subtle fibers, gray ink stains, light cloud textures, aged edges, and muted black, sepia, red seal, and pale blue-gray tones. High information density but elegant and readable.

Layout: Top third contains a huge expressive black brush-calligraphy title across the page, with a small red seal and a vertical author label at the upper right. Under the title, place two centered subtitle lines in small serif Chinese type: “洞庭天下水，岳阳天下楼” and “以楼观湖，以景寄志，以文见心”. The left column is a structured knowledge-analysis panel; the center contains three large quoted key sentences; the right half is dominated by a dramatic Yueyang Tower illustration above cliffs and Dongting Lake. Bottom third contains comparison cards, a location map, two small literary reference cards, an author-ideal card, and a keyword strip.

Main illustration: Paint Yueyang Tower as a multi-eaved traditional wooden pavilion on a high rocky cliff, facing a vast misty lake at sunset. Include layered mountains, drifting clouds, birds, tiny boats on the lake, water reflections, rugged rocks, pine-like vegetation, and mist rising from the cliff. At lower right, show one robed ancient Chinese scholar seen from behind in gray ink, standing on rocks and looking toward the tower. Add a vertical inscription beside the tower reading “洞庭天下水 / 岳阳天下楼” with a small red seal.

Left knowledge panel: Use a vertical heading in a gray ink blot reading “知识解析”. Include exactly 8 numbered analysis items, each with a circled number and short Chinese body text: 1 Author, 2 Text genre, 3 Creative background, 4 Place, 5 Famous sentence, 6 Structural features, 7 Emotional layers, 8 Cultural meaning. Add one small red boxed date label near item 3 reading “庆历六年”. Keep all text compact, like a teaching slide.

Center quote section: Add a narrow vertical label reading “核心引文”. Include exactly 3 large quoted excerpts, separated by thin decorative horizontal rules with small red dots: “先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。”; “此则岳阳楼之大观也。”; “览物之情，得无异乎？”.

Bottom middle comparison card: Draw a bordered cream card titled “情景对照：景随情转，借由景生”. Inside it, create exactly 2 contrasting columns: left column “阴雨霏霏” describing gloomy rain, waves, and melancholy; right column “春和景明” describing bright spring, calm waves, and joy. Put a round center badge reading “对照”, with small ink cloud and sun doodles.

Bottom information row: Create exactly 4 boxed sections from left to right. Section 1 is a “位置示意” location card with a simplified map of Hunan and a red dot labeled “湖南·岳阳”. Section 2 is a Dongting Lake card titled “洞庭湖” with a small sailboat illustration and brief notes about vast lake water and mist. Section 3 is a reference card titled “巴陵胜状（节选）” with a small mountain-water sketch and brief excerpt text. Section 4 is a card titled “士大夫人格理想” explaining concern for the world, responsibility, and moral character.

Bottom keyword strip: Add a red label “关键词”, followed by exactly 6 keyword groups separated by slashes and small icons: “岳阳楼”, “洞庭湖”, “忧乐精神”, “家国情怀”, “北宋散文”, “千古名篇”. Add two small red square seal stamps at the bottom right.

Typography and style: Combine bold wild brush calligraphy for the title, neat traditional Chinese serif type for educational notes, and thin line dividers. Use ink-wash realism mixed with PPT infographic layout. Keep all visible text in Chinese, crisp and legible. Avoid modern sans-serif UI styling, neon colors, cartoon effects, watermarks, or English text.
title: Ancient Chinese Literature PPT Poster
description: Creates a dense antique ink-wash Chinese teaching poster for analyzing a classical literary work such as Yueyang Tower.

content:
Create a clean 2x2 grid on a pure white studio background featuring 4 large 3D typographic sculptures, each a single character built entirely from filmmaking equipment from a different era. The four glyphs are exactly 4 characters: top-left letter A, top-right number 5, bottom-left letter X, bottom-right number 9. Each character should be front-facing, centered in its quadrant, legible but formed from a dense pile of realistic cinema tools and on-set props, with believable occlusion, weight, and construction logic. Use high-end Cinema 4D product visualization, subtle ambient occlusion, soft three-point studio lighting with a softbox overhead, crisp shadows, realistic materials, and isolated composition.

Top-left: the letter A made from early cinema and silent-era equipment, assembled from vintage wooden tripods, hand-cranked film cameras, brass lenses, reels, megaphones, bell-shaped horns, matte black metal parts, leather straps, and aged wood. Surface qualities should include worn varnished wood, black crackle paint, brass tarnish, scuffed metal, and dusty antique patina. The silhouette should feel chaotic but readable, with tripod legs and old camera bodies defining the A shape.

Top-right: the number 5 made from mid-century analog filmmaking gear, assembled from classic film cameras, magazine reels, metal canisters, brown leather cases, audio accessories, silver fabric packs, director chairs, cylindrical lenses, grips, and vintage production bags. Materials should emphasize brushed aluminum, leather, canvas, rubber, and weathered industrial finishes. The 5 should be chunky and balanced, with stacked props tightly packed into the glyph.

Bottom-left: the letter X made from late 20th century video and broadcast equipment, assembled from shoulder-mount camcorders, portable recorders, battery packs, coiled cables, cassette-like modules, control panels, worn blue and gray plastic housings, and rugged field electronics. Include visible wiring and taped components. Materials should feel utilitarian and slightly battered, with dark plastic, anodized metal, stickers, rubber grips, and yellow accent details. The crossing diagonals of the X must be clear and substantial.

Bottom-right: the number 9 made from contemporary digital cinema and virtual production gear, assembled from modern cinema cameras, compact monitors, LED light panels, drones, gimbals, matte boxes, black modular accessories, and a vivid green chroma screen wrap forming part of the numeral. Include sleek vents, carbon fiber textures, matte black metal, polished glass, and bright green screen fabric as the dominant accent color. The 9 should feel the most modern and refined, with modular precision and clean industrial design.

Keep the background plain and uncluttered, no extra text, no floating objects, no flat typography, no 2D rendering. The sculptures should look like physical objects at realistic scale, highly detailed, photorealistic, and suitable as a graphic design asset.

content:
Based on the {argument name="subject" default="subject"}, create a high-quality visual of a "Landscape Archive Model" suitable for serial publication.

This is not a regular map, landscape illustration, or urban rendering, but a high-end archival visual combining "2D map drawings + 3D regional models + professional explanation systems + museum exhibition feel." The image should resemble a realistically crafted geographical research model, urban planning sandbox, architectural proposal model, or world-building exhibit, possessing a professional, restrained, precise, and tactile premium quality.

[Basic Settings]
Subject: {argument name="subject details" default="subject, e.g., Crater Lake / Guangzhou / Chongqing Mountain City / Island City / Ancient Ruins / Post-apocalyptic Ruins / Fantasy Continent / Game Capital"}
Subject Type: [Natural Landscape / Urban Space / Mixed Landscape]
Core Subject: {argument name="core subject" default="core subject, e.g., crater, canyon, mountain range, lake, CBD, old town, landmark group, island city, ruin group, main city area"}
Content Focus: [Terrain Elevation / Urban Landmarks / Road Network / Hydrology / Relationship between Nature and City / Setting Collection Display]
Style Direction: [Geographic Surveying Style, Paper-cut Model Style, Architectural Proposal Style, Museum Archive Style, Urban Planning Style, Game Setting Collection Style]
Primary Color: [Off-white, Light Gray, Parchment White, Sand, Snow White]
Secondary Color: [Earthy Brown, Rock Gray, Cold Gray, Light Blue, Moss Green]
Accent Color: [Black thin lines, Red routes, Blue hydrological lines, Yellow numbering marks]
Aspect Ratio: [16:9 Landscape / 3:4 Portrait / 4:5 Portrait / 1:1 Square]

[Visual Structure]
The main subject is a rectangular map model board placed on a clean tabletop or white cloth surface. The base plate has realistic thickness with a visible section structure, like a refined map slice or model base. The map surface is covered with a clear but restrained layer of information, including contour lines, road networks, hydrological lines, zoning boundaries, geographical textures, a sense of coordinates, slight annotations, and drawing borders.

In the center or off-center area of the map, a 3D main model "grows" out of the 2D map, serving as the visual core of the entire image.

If the [Subject Type] is Natural Landscape:
The subject may consist of mountains, canyons, craters, lakes, basins, islands, glaciers, faults, and coastlines, emphasizing terrain elevation, layered contour structures, rock wall textures, and natural terrain fluctuations.

If the [Subject Type] is Urban Space:
The subject may consist of core urban areas, CBDs, old city blocks, landmark clusters, waterfronts, road network nodes, bridges, water systems, and parks, emphasizing building volumes, urban recognizability, spatial hierarchy, and planning structures.

If the [Subject Type] is Mixed Landscape:
It should integrate both natural terrain and man-made environments, such as mountain cities, island cities, ancient ruins, post-apocalyptic ruins, fantasy capitals, or sci-fi bases, allowing natural geography and urban structure to jointly form the core visual.

[Detail Requirements]
- Retain the feel of map drawings and professional information on the model surface.
- Terrain areas should have contour lines, slope layers, and relationships of depression and elevation.
- Building areas should have a sense of volume, block relationships, and clear hierarchy.
- Water bodies use low-saturation light blue.
- Green spaces, forests, parks, and mountains use moss green or low-saturation green.
- Road networks, paths, traffic axes, or exploration lines can be represented by fine lines but should not overwhelm the main subject.
- Landmark buildings or key structures should have clear recognizability.
- For fantasy, sci-fi, or game settings, maintain the archive model and drawing display feel rather than a pure scene illustration.

[Explanation System]
The edges of the map board need a complete and restrained explanation module, including:
- Outer and inner frames
- Scale bar
- Legend area
- Title area
- Archive number
- Index markers
- Annotation labels
- Simple symbolic explanations
Text doesn't need to be fully readable, but the overall structure must present a realistic, clear, precise, and orderly archival layout.

[Composition and Camera]
Use an oblique isometric or sandbox-style composition. The camera observes the entire model board from about 30 to 45 degrees above, allowing the audience to see the map plane, 3D subject height, edge thickness, and explanation areas. The visual focus is on the central main model, with the reading path being: first the core subject, then the surrounding terrain/road/water/block information, and finally the legend, scale, and explanation area.

[Material and Lighting]
The overall look needs realistic model photography texture:
- Paper texture
- Map printing texture
- Paper-cut or sandbox model feel
- Architectural model or terrain slice texture
- Soft natural light
- Delicate realistic shadows
- Clean background
- Low saturation, high-end, and restrained
Avoid cartoonishness, cheap game UI feel, excessive clutter, or excessive showboating. Highlight the unified visual of "map base board + 3D subject + professional explanation system."

The final effect should resemble a landscape archive model image that can be used for geographical education, urban research, architectural proposals, cultural tourism visual themes, world-building setting collections, or high-end series covers.
title: Landscape Archive Model Map
description: A detailed prompt for creating professional museum-style landscape models that combine 2D cartography with 3D terrain slices and annotations.

content: Please create a high-completion, high-narrative tension 「Shadow Ensemble Cover」 suitable for serialized release based on the [Subject: {argument name="character name" default="Write character names"}]. This is not an ordinary character illustration, nor a simple combat poster, but an "ensemble action cover" with the feel of a novel cover, manga visual, game promotion, and dark fantasy illustration. The image needs to be composed of a huge spiritual core figure, multiple mid-ground action characters, background threat elements, local energy light effects, and a blank title area to form a complete character faction and worldview cover. [Basic Settings] Theme: {argument name="scene theme" default="Jujutsu battle / Dark Journey to the West / Cyber Hunter / Monster Hunting Team / Doomsday Survivor / Magic Academy Battle Group"} Work Name: [Work Name] Series Name / Brand Name: [Brand Name or Series Name] Subtitle: [Subtitle] Style Direction: {argument name="style" default="Dark fantasy, retro manga cover, hand-painted impasto, fantasy novel cover, game visual"} Main Tone: Dark green-black-gray / Deep blue neon / Dark brown-gold-red / Sand yellow-iron rust / Deep purple-gold Accent Color: Blood red energy, turquoise spell light, golden divine light, blue lightning Frame Ratio: 2:3 vertical / 3:4 vertical / 4:5 vertical / 9:16 vertical [Screen Structure] Use a vertical cover composition. There must be a huge visual figure as the spiritual core and atmosphere-dominating element. This person can be a profile, half-body, back, front stare, or huge silhouette, occupying the right, top, or main background area, with a calm, mysterious, and oppressive expression, not necessarily participating in the battle, but must govern the temperament of the whole picture. Arrange 3 to 6 action characters in the middle ground to form a combat faction ensemble. There should be clear division of labor and posture differences between characters, such as charging, holding a knife, casting spells, defense, summoning, jumping, alerting, long-range attack, etc. Avoid characters standing still; a strong rhythmic action and visual movement must be formed. Add enemy threats or worldview elements in the background, such as monsters, giants, villain shadows, mechanical legions, demons, ruins, forests, alien spaces, battlefield smoke, or city disasters. Background threats should not overshadow the main subject but wrap around characters like shadows to enhance the sense of crisis and narrative depth. Set 1 to 2 high-saturation energy hotspots, such as red flame fists, blue lightning, green cursed aura, purple magic, golden divine light, or white sword light. The energy effect should be concentrated on key characters or weapons, forming a visual focus, not uniformly lit across the screen. [Composition] The overall structure is "large spiritual core character + mid-ground action ensemble + background threat shadow + bottom or side blank title area". The image can use diagonal lines to organize characters, letting the ensemble rush from top-left to bottom-right or from bottom to center, forming a strong forward push. Retain a clear blank title area, suggested at the bottom-left, bottom, or side. Use off-white, gray-white, light paper color, or low-saturation background colors for the blank area to place the [Brand Name / Work Name / Subtitle]. The title typography should have a publication cover feel, using elegant serif fonts, retro title letters, manga cover titles, or high-end magazine-style layout. The text area must be clear and not completely blocked by characters and background. Do not make the edges a complete rectangle; use irregular brush edges, ink diffusion, torn paper style, or natural dissipation to let characters and background grow out of the paper, enhancing the hand-drawn cover feel and artistic quality. [Visual Style] The overall style should be a combination of hand-painted impasto and manga cover, with paper texture, brushstrokes, dark layers, and a retro publication temperament. Lighting is mainly low-key dark light with a darkened background, clear character silhouettes, and high-contrast focal points provided by local energy light. The image should not be excessively clean; it should retain hand-painted textures, paper grain, edge strokes, and dark mist. Use low-saturation dark tones mainly, supplemented by a small amount of high-saturation energy colors. The overall atmosphere should have a sense of pressure, mystery, combat, and worldview thickness. [Visual Goal] The final image should look like a mature fantasy novel cover, manga special cover, game character faction visual, or IP promo poster. It needs to possess: 1. A clear main visual character; 2. An ensemble with rhythmic movement; 3. Clear enemy threats or worldview background; 4. Strong but restrained energy effects; 5. A readable title text area; 6. An overall texture of a retro hand-drawn cover. Ensure the image is informative but not cluttered, with clear character levels and visual gravity, suitable for continuing to generate the same series with different themes.
